package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"encoding/json"
	"html/template"
	"io"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type T struct{}

func (T) Save(_ context.Context, body io.Reader, raw json.RawMessage) (string, error) {
	return string(raw), nil
}
